sloka: निवृत्तवनवासो ऽसि प्रतिज्ञा सफला कृता ।रावणं च रणे हत्वा देवास्ते परितोषिताः ।। ६.१२२.२३ ।।
transliteration: nivṛttavanavāso 'si pratijñā saphalā kṛtā ।rāvaṇaṁ ca raṇe hatvā devāste paritoṣitāḥ ।। 6.122.23 ।।

translations.english: "The period of your exile has been completed, my promise has been fulfilled in the battlefield and the gods have also gratified you."
